# Next Learn Academy

> > Next Learn Academy is a trusted UK online education provider offering CPD and Ofqual-accredited professional certification courses across accounting, business management, and animal care.

Next Learn Academy specializes in career-focused online learning with accreditations from CPD and Ofqual. The platform serves professionals seeking to advance their skills in finance, business, and animal care sectors through flexible, industry-relevant certification programs.

## Key Topics

- CPD Accreditation
- Ofqual Regulation
- Accounting Software
- Business Management
- Professional Certification
- Online Courses
- QuickBooks
- Sage 50
- Animal Care

- Management Training

## Accounting & Finance Courses

- [Accounting Software](https://nextlearnacademy.com/courses/accounting-software-1): Accounting software courses including Sage 50 and QuickBooks training
- [Bookkeeping](https://nextlearnacademy.com/courses/bookkeeping-1): CPD-accredited bookkeeping and financial accounting certification
- [Financial Accounting](https://nextlearnacademy.com/courses/financial-accounting-1): Financial accounting and corporate finance CPD-accredited courses
- [Payroll Management](https://nextlearnacademy.com/courses/payroll-management-1): Payroll management and accounting software training with CPD accreditation
